4 اسعدهُ ٱللّٰهُ , [inf. n. إِسْعَادٌ,] God rendered him prosperous, fortunate, happy, or in a state of felicity; (S, Msb, K;) as also ↓ سَعَدَهُ , aor.
سَعَدَ ; (T, Msb, TA;) but the former is the more common. (Msb.) And اسعد ٱللّٰهُ جَدَّهُ, (A, L,) God made his good fortune to increase; as also ↓ سَعَدَ جَدَّهُ. (L.) And accord. to Az, اسعدهُ ٱللّٰهُ and ↓ سَعَدَهُ signify God aided, assisted, or helped, him; and accommodated, adapted, or disposed, him to the right course. (L, TA.) See also 3, in four places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
